review_notes: I read the whole file. The only new concept is `measureT`, a density-weighted Lebesgue measure on (-1, 1]. I grepped Mathlib for arcsine-distribution measures and for other uses of the weight `√(1 - x ^ 2)⁻¹`. The only hits are this file and `ChebyshevGauss.lean`. `ChebyshevGauss.lean` imports and uses `measureT`, so it is a consumer, not a competitor. I found no existing Mathlib measure for this weight. The supporting lemmas (`integral_measureT`, `integrable_measureT`, `integral_measureT_eq_integral_cos`) are API for this new measure. I judged any remaining concerns to be about theorem or proof style, which the rubric excludes. I have no justified finding.
